title: Singular negative yes/no questions
focus: Form enkö, etkö, and eikö questions followed by ole.

exercises.instruction: Choose the best question form.
exercises.prompt: Complete “Am I not safe?” ____ minä ole turvassa?
exercises.explanation: En takes -kö to form enkö; ole follows after the subject.

optionFeedback.enkö: Correct. En takes -kö to form enkö; ole follows after the subject.
optionFeedback.etkö: “etkö” does not fit this subject or construction. En takes -kö to form enkö; ole follows after the subject.
optionFeedback.eikö: “eikö” does not fit this subject or construction. En takes -kö to form enkö; ole follows after the subject.

parts.role: negative question verb: begins the question and carries person agreement
parts.formation: en + -kö forms enkö

parts.role: subject: the person or people described by the sentence
parts.formation: subject pronoun; no ending is added

parts.role: main verb after the negative question verb
parts.formation: olla stays in the fixed form ole after the negative verb

parts.role: context: tells the location or state
parts.formation: supplied as a complete fixed expression; no change is required

exercises.misconceptionCategory: Singular negative olla questions: form not yet secure
